kept_lines: For over 40 years Kopsa Otte CPAs and Advisors has been working with salons, spas & distributors to help owners interpret their financial statements, achieve their goals, and strategize to pay the least amount of tax possible within the law. Their team of tax planners and analysts work with beauty-based businesses in 45 states to interpret the foreign language of tax laws and how they impact tax liability.

Kopsa Otte meets with clients constantly to discuss possible tax strategies. In addition to tax planning and preparation, clients rely on Kopsa Otte as their trusted advisors for budgeting, break-even analysis, industry averages, succession planning, projections and much more.
